value.rationale: A natural equivariant topology problem for an unrestricted graph Cartesian strip family is reduced exactly and integrally to simpler graph matching complexes. An odd-height join versus even-height boundary-whiskered reduction gives a structural parity dichotomy with Aut(G) naturality. For all k>=2, P_n grids with n=2 mod 3 have contractible geometric fixed loci despite difficult ambient homotopy; the n=0,1 residue cases admit suspension formulas. Neither a tiny numerical gain nor an arbitrary graph sample.
